name: @avatark/private-reflection-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 19's private-reflection firewall: a PrivateReflectionRecord is a visitor's own content, additive, owner-scoped only -- never a WorldEvent, never an input to deriveWorldEvents/Adaptation/World Memory, never readable by anything other than its own author. No repository method here ever supports a world-wide or cross-user read; that asymmetry (get-by-owner, never listByWorld) is the structural half of the firewall, the dependency-boundary regex scan in lib/runtimeKernel/dependencyBoundaries.test.ts is the other half.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
